text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah... A package arrived from home.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "Since Kei-chan doesn't do well in the cold, I sent some warm pajamas. Make sure to try them on!"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I'm not a kid anymore, you know.
—Thank you, Mom.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
Maybe I'll try putting it on right away.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Huh?
Is it just me, or is it a bit tight around my waist...?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Still, there's no way Mom would get the size wrong, which means... wait, what?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Look, she's been training hard since early morning!
Miracle-san is seriously stoic, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Yeah. We need to follow her example too!

And so, after continuing with her rigorous training,
K.S. Miracle was able to get her weight back to normal.
